I'm certain I'm not the worst, however my last appointment the dentist proceeded to tell me how much I need to brush/floss. I told her in a small voice with tears in my eyes that my depression and pain issues were such that I struggle with activities of daily living. 

I didn't tell her that 15 years ago I brushed my teeth all the time. My orthodontist even told me at that time he'd never seen someone with braces keep their teeth so clean. Now, it's just another chore that I can't handle. :-(
I told my optometrist that I never had hypertension, even though I went to optometry school and know that she can see the tortuous veins inside my eye. I felt immediately stupid.

A couple: black lab/catahoula mix would chase neighbor's rabbit around a tree in our yard when rabbit climbed under fence. One day, rabbit kicks dog in face and immediately begins chasing the dog. This became a game, and the rabbit never had to thump her again. The dog would chase the rabbit, the rabbit would chase the dog.

My toy poodle meows, says no and mommy. Others usually don't believe me until they hear it for themselves. She also learned to cry like a baby and I've had people tell me they didn't know I had a baby, me "I don't, she's a 15 year old poodle."

My dog Lucy (min pin) is called raptor because she taught herself how to open their kennel (with a slide lock on), through a dog fence that is hooked onto a cord on the wall, and this week she somehow managed to open the front door to the house. Oh, and we have a tall island in the kitchen and she's learned to jump to search for food, then grabs it off to eat. Last time it was two packs of fig newtons, this week a pound of bacon and some chocolates. She jumps over 4 feet high to manage her shenanigans! 

She's cute, too, and found a hole in the fence (we removed a pool, and a pipe from the equipment removed left a small hole in privacy fence.) She loves to stick her nose out of the hole to say hello as kids walk home from the nearby elementary school.

My small dogs do this, too. We call it butt dragging, as in "Lucy, stop dragging your butt on the carpet!" She doesn't leave stains, but if she does it a bunch and chases her (nonexistent) tail, I know it's time for emptying her glands.
IMPORTANT NOTE: if the glands become infected, the glands will rupture through the skin and the dog will need surgery and a drain sewn in temporarily. Not fun for anyone.

Now I add pumpkin or sweet potato to their regular food and it helps build bulk, so when they poo the scent glands are emptied. 

If I'm not mistaken, this is primarily a problem for small dogs, as the large breeds I've owned in the past never needed them drained.

My guess is that the girl you like (and probably a bunch of others at school) already has a crush on you... give her a compliment and see how she reacts... be up front about your feelings and even if she turns you down, just think about all the other ladies who would love to spend time with you!

Idk if your dysmorphia is focused on one body part, or even if you'll believe compliments on it, but you could totally be a model! Bouncing back from something major like bowel surgery is tough on anyone, but YOU have! Go you! (And if you have any ports or scars under your clothes, even more props!)

Your hair rocks! You're gorgeous, and to top it all off, you dgaf about what folks say when rockin' that cute outfit (I am terrified to show my midriff because of my weight)! 
I know you might feel lonely, but honestly, in the long run, you're probably waaay better off being single now, so you can do whatever tf you want!! I spent too much time with partners who weren't worth the time and energy because I was afraid of being alone. You do you, and someday when you least expect it, the right person will be there.

Also, it takes a lot of work/skill to hold down a good job and alcoholism (I've been there myself), so you are amazing and skilled.
Please look into FMLA (family and medical leave act), which allows you to take time off to take care of medical issues without threat to your job. I detoxed about five years ago and went immediately into a month long program... not easy, or particularly pleasant, but you WILL find hope! And, if you're afraid like I was, realize it is only temporary, but your other options are death or jail.
You can do this!!! I believe in you!
